title: LERHYTTAN door
description: LERHYTTAN door, light gray, 12x40" The solid wood frame with bevelled edges and inset veneer panel give LERHYTTAN kitchen fronts a classic, traditional look. The light grey finish creates a cozy kitchen with timeless feel. You can choose to mount the door on the right or left side.
features: Complete with UTRUSTA 110° hinge with built-in damper for kitchen, 2-pack, sold separately.
Requires a knob or a handle
May be completed with LERHYTTAN cover panels, plinths and decorative strips in light gray.
materialAndCare: Frame: Solid birch, Tinted clear acrylic lacquer; Panel: Fiberboard, Birch veneer, Tinted clear acrylic lacquer; Panel back side: Birch veneer, Tinted clear acrylic lacquer
